title: Bisaya basics
about: The most common words of Bisaya (Cebuano), counted in the Cebuano web text of OPUS's NLLB collection (ODC-By 1.0) and grouped by root with tools/course/ceb/rank.mjs, most common first, 50 to a unit. Names of people and places, and English words, are left out. Verbs are listed by their root (kaon, to eat), as Bisaya dictionaries list them. Each word has one short everyday sentence that uses it the way people in Cebu say it, with its English translation; ⟦ ⟧ marks the part that translates the word.

words.meaning: at; in; to; of (a place, a direction)
that; who; which (joins a word to what describes it)
words.sentence: Mao ni ang libro nga akong gibasa.
words.translation: This is the book ⟦that⟧ I read.

words.meaning: the (marks who or what the sentence is about)

words.translation: I didn't go ⟦because⟧ it was raining.

words.meaning: it is (the one); that's it; mao ba?: really?
this (short for kini); of (before a name)
there is; to have (adunay ...: there is a ...)
(before a person's name or a title like Mama)
also; too; again (in speech also sad, pud)
a; some (before the thing a verb acts on)

words.sentence: Nagtuon ko og maayo aron makapasar.
words.translation: I studied hard ⟦so that⟧ I'd pass.

words.meaning: to say; like (ingon niini: like this)
this; of this (after a verb or sa)
can; may; it's possible; to become

words.sentence: Pwede nako gamiton ang imong telepono?
Ganahan ko sa prutas, labi na sa mangga.

words.meaning: so; then (softens a question or an answer)
even; even if; any (bisan unsa: anything)
words.translation: He worked ⟦even though⟧ he was sick.

words.meaning: you; your (after a noun or a verb)
but (a bit formal; in speech pero)
words.sentence: Gusto ko moadto, apan wala koy oras.

words.meaning: there is; is (at a place); to have

words.sentence: Nakita ba nimo ang akong yawe?

words.meaning: me; my; by me (after a noun or a verb)
our (yours and mine; before a noun)

words.sentence: Wala ko kaadto tungod sa ulan.
words.translation: I couldn't go ⟦because of⟧ the rain.

words.meaning: to do; to make; work, deed

words.meaning: to know (kahibalo: knows how; nahibal-an: found out)

words.sentence: Unsa ang labing dali nga paagi?
Nakaila mi pinaagi sa usa ka higala.
Duha ka tuig na mi dinhi.

to him; to her; him; her (after a word like sa)

until; up to; as far as

words.meaning: glad; happy (nalipay: was glad; malipayon: cheerful; kalipay: joy)
only; just (a bit formal; in speech lang)

words.meaning: so; oh, really (on finding something out)
to come back; to return; again
us; our; by us (not you; after a noun or a verb)
to me; me (after a word like sa)

this; of this (in speech, for niini)

words.sentence: Unsa ang buot ipasabot niini nga pulong?

words.meaning: to you; you (more than one; after a word like sa)
that; of that (in speech, for niana)

words.meaning: front (atubangan: in front of); to face
words.sentence: Naa ko sa atubangan sa simbahan.

words.sentence: Moadto ko didto kaduha sa usa ka semana.

words.meaning: to send (on an errand); to order; command

words.meaning: according to; so they say (matud pa)
